snippet.title: [Indie Game]Anxiety Puppy - Steam Page Trailer
snippet.description: Anxiety Puppy is a 2D interactive narrative game that focuses on anxiety. In the game, anxiety is personified as a little puppy. Players will explore its story and try to coexist with it. Go find its traces and give it a hug.
